chapter: Image, travel and Black, Brown and Beige
title: Denver luncheon and the rattlesnake bedroom slippers
summary: Greer shows up at a union luncheon in bedroom slippers.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I remember one time we were on our way to California and we had a two hour lay-off in Denver. And a band met us at the station, pulled up to our Pullman. And the guy, what was his name, he was head of the union out there. He said, "You all hurry up and get dressed, we got a luncheon up in the station for you guys." Man, I got all dressed up in a grey outfit and man, my feet hurt me, I had a pair of rattlesnake bedroom slippers, man I'm all dressed to kill and Duke looked down, I had on these bedroom slippers. They were expensive. Duke said, "Hey, man, you got on bedroom slippers." I said, "Man, the way my feet are feeling, I'm lucky to be caught
barefoot. I said, "You want me here, don't you? If you don't, I can go right back in them." He said, oh, come on.

You know, there was a lot of funny incidents. And they had this band, all the band from the union guys in Colorado. They made up some jive band, playing in the station, making all that noise. Here's this guy, Ben Webster, hanging like a dog. Toby done high. But they made it and had a good time. Yeah.
